# SystemsArchitect.io

> > AI-powered cloud architecture platform providing best practices, tutorials, and study resources for AWS, Azure, and GCP using Terraform, Python, Node.js, and TypeScript.

SystemsArchitect.io offers 18K+ best practices across 136 cloud services, featuring the 6U requirements methodology, 7 core workflows, and interactive study tools. Founded in 2020, the platform democratizes multi-cloud knowledge through comprehensive documentation, architecture frameworks, and hands-on tutorials.

## Key Topics

- AWS
- Azure
- GCP
- Terraform
- Python
- Node.js
- TypeScript
- Cloud Architecture
- Best Practices
- Requirements Gathering (6U Methodology)
- Systems Architecture
- IAM & Security
- GDPR Compliance
- Design Patterns
- API Reference

## Getting Started

- [Systems Architect | SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/docs/intro): Introduction to SystemsArchitect.io framework and 7 core workflows
- [SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/info): Documentation hub for AWS, Azure, GCP best practices and API reference
- [Cloud Solutions and Best Practices | SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/services): 136 AWS, Azure, GCP service guides covering security and optimization
- [SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/about): About page: 18K+ best practices, mission to democratize cloud knowledge

## Requirements & Architecture Frameworks

- [6U Request | SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/docs/request/introduction): 6U user-focused requirements gathering methodology and meetings
- [User Interface | SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/docs/request/user-interface): UI requirements gathering guide for initial app discussions
- [Systems Architecture Diagram Types | SystemsArchitect.io](https://systemsarchitect.io/docs/requirements/systems/diagram-types): Guide to architecture diagram types: UML, sequence, flowchart, network
